header: This reads the page images of the archived circulars with the two Gemini readers (a primary and a checker) and SAVES each reading in reread-cache/gemini/. Those saved readings are what scripts/ocr-consensus.ts compares with the stored text. It is READ-ONLY: it never writes to the database, and I made it so a page already read by a reader is never read (or paid for) again. npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/gemini-read-archive.ts --plan how many pages still need a reading npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/gemini-read-archive.ts [--ids 34,20] [--max-calls 200] [--pause-ms 3000] Models: OCR_PRIMARY_MODEL (default gemini-3.1-pro-preview) and OCR_CHECK_MODEL (default gemini-3.8-flash).
